en: A vintage multi-view postcard printed in black and white. The upper left image shows a small chapel with a tall steeple labeled "Petersberger Kapelle." The upper right panoramic image shows a village with church towers and surrounding countryside, labeled "St. Peter b. Graz mit Petersbergen." The lower image shows a manor house or small palace with a gabled roof and garden in front, labeled "Schloss Reinthal." The captions are in German and printed in a serif typeface on a light background.
